name: world_percussion
character: percussion-led folk or world music (frame drums, tabla, djembe, dhol): a cyclic rhythm is the form and the melodic line is optional
why: a shipped starting point for `gate_profiles.py new <name> --from world_percussion`: the figures are starting values chosen for the genre structure, not measurements of a piece; measure with scripts/rca.py and state the real figures in the project profile
